mapper.select: SELECT bt.id AS transactionId, bt.task_id AS taskId, v.biz_task_id AS taskBusinessId, v.model, v.provider, v.duration, v.status AS taskStatus, bt.amount, bt.balance_after AS balanceAfter, bt.frozen_after AS frozenAfter, bt.remark, bt.create_time AS createTime FROM balance_transaction bt LEFT JOIN video_task v ON v.id = bt.task_id WHERE bt.user_id = #{userId} AND bt.type = 'SETTLE' ORDER BY bt.create_time DESC, bt.id DESC
